pr_body:
The `JoinValidationService` doesn't need to send the cluster state if
we're not currently the master - instead it can just send a join ping.
This means it doesn't need to do any work adjusting the blocks.

Closes #97313
pr_title: Fall back to join ping if not master

review_comment: This whole branch is for joining nodes of version before 8.3.0. I wonder if we need to be optimizing/changing this at all.
This branch needs to be adjusted to handle the case where `clusterStateSupplier` returns `null`. I'd rather do that than have a different `clusterStateSupplier` for the BwC case.
Sounds good thanks for the explanation!

> `|| clusterState.nodes().isLocalNodeElectedMaster() == false) {`

This line is new and previously it was an assertion. Why is that?

I don't see where this used to be an assertion, sorry if I'm missing something. This is really just folding in the `isLocalNodeElectedMaster` check that previously was here:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/0b5f19bdfcd639134d36674277e748d72d4926d2/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/cluster/coordination/Coordinator.java#L695
You are right, did not check correctly.
Maybe it's worth adding a comment explaining why the serialized cluster state can be null
